# Activity feed (`activity-feed`)

What happened in the home, newest first: icon, what changed, by what, and how long ago.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createActivityFeed` (types in `dist/web/home/info/activityFeed.d.ts`): `section.mh-activity-feed`: per day a `__day` with a `__day-label` heading and an `ol.__list` of `__item`s (`--accent | --success | --warning | --danger`). Each holds a `__row` (a `div`, or a `button` with `onSelect`) with an `__icon` badge, `__text` (`__title`, `__by`) and a `time.__time` saying how long ago (the clock time under an earlier day's heading), the full time as its tooltip. `__more` and `__empty` at the end.

```ts
export function createActivityFeed(options: ActivityFeedOptions): ActivityFeedHandle;

export interface ActivityFeedOptions extends InfoClockFormat {
  items: readonly ActivityItem[];
  /** The time "ago" counts from. Without it the feed uses the clock and refreshes itself every 30 seconds. */
  now?: InfoTime;
  /** Day headings (Today, Yesterday, Monday 14 October); default true. */
  groupByDay?: boolean;
  /** Most entries shown. */
  max?: number;
  /** Level of the day headings (default 3). */
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4;
  /** Accessible name (default "Activity"). */
  label?: string;
  /** Makes each entry a button. */
  onSelect?: (id: string) => void;
  /** Shows a "Show older" button at the end. */
  onMore?: () => void;
  labels?: Partial<ActivityFeedLabels>;
}

export interface ActivityFeedHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  update(changes: Partial<ActivityFeedOptions>): void;
  /** Stops the refresh timer. */
  destroy(): void;
}

export interface ActivityItem {
  id: string;
  /** What changed ("Back door opened", "Heating set to 21 °C"). */
  title: string;
  /** By what or whom ("Sam", "Morning routine", "Motion in the hall"). */
  by?: string | null;
  time: InfoTime;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  tone?: ActivityTone;
}

export interface ActivityFeedLabels {
  justNow: string;
  /** Spoken before `by`. */
  by: string;
  more: string;
  empty: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { mdiDoorOpen, mdiLightbulbOutline, mdiLockOutline, mdiThermostat } from '@mdi/js';
import { createActivityFeed, type ActivityItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const ago = (minutes: number): number => Date.now() - minutes * 60_000;

let items: ActivityItem[] = [
  { id: '1', title: 'Back door opened', by: 'Robin', time: ago(1), icon: mdiDoorOpen, tone: 'accent' },
  { id: '2', title: 'Heating set to 21 °C', by: 'Evening routine', time: ago(14), icon: mdiThermostat },
  { id: '3', title: 'Hall light turned on', by: 'Motion', time: ago(52), icon: mdiLightbulbOutline },
];

const older: ActivityItem = { id: '4', title: 'Front door locked', time: ago(60 * 26), icon: mdiLockOutline };

const feed = createActivityFeed({
  items,
  onSelect: (id) => location.assign(`#/activity/${id}`),
  onMore: () => {
    items = [...items, older];
    feed.update({ items, onMore: undefined });
  },
});

document.body.append(feed.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { mdiDoorOpen, mdiLightbulbOutline, mdiLockOutline, mdiThermostat } from '@mdi/js';
import { ActivityFeed } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { ActivityItem } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const ago = (minutes: number): number => Date.now() - minutes * 60_000;

export function ActivityFeedExample() {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<ActivityItem[]>(() => [
    { id: '1', title: 'Back door opened', by: 'Robin', time: ago(1), icon: mdiDoorOpen, tone: 'accent' },
    { id: '2', title: 'Heating set to 21 °C', by: 'Evening routine', time: ago(14), icon: mdiThermostat },
    { id: '3', title: 'Hall light turned on', by: 'Motion', time: ago(52), icon: mdiLightbulbOutline },
  ]);
  const [hasOlder, setHasOlder] = useState(true);
  const loadOlder = () => {
    const older: ActivityItem = { id: '4', title: 'Front door locked', time: ago(60 * 26), icon: mdiLockOutline };
    setItems((list) => [...list, older]);
    setHasOlder(false);
  };
  return (
    <ActivityFeed
      items={items}
      onSelect={(id) => location.assign(`#/activity/${id}`)}
      onMore={hasOlder ? loadOlder : undefined}
    />
  );
}
```
